about_the_game:
Give your heroes a magitech base to visit when they need to gather even more power to defeat the demon king with the KR Solar Base Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a mirror to their lunar base set, this time offering us a MZ-sized tileset that has warmer tones and some burning hot lava. Build a space station located on a planet much too close to a star, or leave an ancient temple deep in a volcano for your heroes to find that gives them new and powerful equipment to take on any challenge.

A1, A2, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets are ready to help you build desolate regions where brown dirt and stone is broken up by rivers of lava and the rare gray machinery that proves your heroes weren’t the first people there. Create metal laboratories that are filled with machines powered by glowing orange crystals, or let your heroes rest up in abandoned houses that still hold the owner’s portraits on the walls and bookshelves with their random knickknacks.

This pack also includes character sprites for doors decorated with careful carvings. Use the carved stone doors to keep the interior areas safe from the hot lava outside, or have the double doors marked with a sun lead straight into the source of power! If you’ve been searching for a tileset that mixes scifi with fantasy and focuses on a world that can’t rely on a normal sun, check out the KR Solar Base Tileset!

Note: Because this is derived from the Lunar Base, it shares many tiles in common, mostly outdoor items like rocks, but recolored to fit the theme. Almost all interior tiles are unique to this set.


The Solar Base Tileset:

Ground tiles:

Water, four types of reddish rock/dirt, tile floor, brick floor, grate, concrete, panel, pebble edge and more!

Walls/roofs:

Stone, white, panel and tile-edged wall, plus metal-edged walls for the base interior and rough rock surface for exterior.

Also includes:

Rock walls with inward slope
Rock edge tiles
Craters and assorted rocks to make a rugged landscape
Shadow tiles to make deep holes, plus glow tiles to do the same
Isometric diamond pillars of various configurations
Metal wall panels
Mechanical pillars
Assorted sci-fi decorations
Panels with controls
Door frame
Various windows
Machines with glowing jewels
Computers
Pillars
Stairs
Elegant palace furniture – seats, beds, etc
Sun doors
Tiled floor decor
Bookcases and decorations
Bright and colorful stained glass
Wall portraits
Lit and unlit wall sconce
and more!

Events and Animations:

Door animations


* MZ/MV Samplemap is included!


Terms of Use:

* This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
* OK to be used in Commercial projects
* Contents can be edited
* OK for use in games with gore
* OK for use in adult-rated games
